text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential: create a simple schedule, break large tasks into smaller steps, and start early so you are not rushed at the end. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important tasks first and avoid wasting energy on less urgent work. Third, scope management matters, because agreeing clearly on what is included—and what is not—prevents extra work from appearing late. Finally, communication is key: tell your team or manager early if something is going wrong or if you need help. With these skills, deadlines become easier to meet.
